name: claude-cowork-dispatch
description: Claude Cowork (persistent VM workspace) + Dispatch (mobile control) — Tier 2 for long-running knowledge work

cowork.description: Persistent VM workspace with file access, code execution, and MCP connectors. Ideal for research, coding, document synthesis, and multi-file operations.

workspaces.name: Eagle Eye R&D
workspaces.description: Competitive analysis, tech scouting, architecture design, vendor evaluation

workspaces.name: Content Production
workspaces.description: Content writing, PDF synthesis, blog drafts, social copy, brand voice work

workspaces.name: Code Operations
workspaces.description: Homelab code, Docker configs, M3TA OS development, agent refactoring, PR workflows

workspaces.name: Client Workspace
workspaces.description: Per-client document preparation, proposal writing, deliverable assembly

use_cases: Synthesize 20+ PDFs into a strategic brief
Refactor agent code across multiple files and open a PR
Research and compile competitive analysis with citations
Build Docker compose files with testing
Write and iterate on long-form content with revision history

dispatch.description: Mobile control surface for Cowork. Submit tasks, check status, and continue work from your phone. Designed for fragmented-attention reality.

patterns.name: On-the-go Research
patterns.example: Continue synthesizing these 20 PDFs into a strategic brief

patterns.name: Remote Code Work
patterns.example: Refactor the QB agent code to support multi-org configs; open a PR when done

patterns.name: Status Check
patterns.example: What's the status of the content brief I submitted this morning?

patterns.name: Urgent Task Submission
patterns.example: Client needs updated proposal by 3pm — use the template in Drive and update pricing

integration_with_apple.note: Create an Apple Shortcut that captures spoken intent + context and POSTs to Dispatch for async execution

escalation_to_computer_use.description: Cowork can escalate to Computer Use when a task explicitly needs GUI interaction that cannot be handled via APIs or code.
pattern: 1. Cowork attempts task via available tools (code, APIs, MCP connectors)
2. If blocked by GUI-only requirement, Cowork flags for Computer Use escalation
3. User approves Computer Use session with scope constraints
4. Computer Use completes the GUI step
5. Control returns to Cowork for remaining work
